definition.label: Transfer carried or surface material
definition.description: Transfer measured material between two distinct objects, each explicitly choosing its height field or material store. Field endpoints use a local X/Z disk with smooth radial falloff; store endpoints use their saved local-litre balance. Supports surface-to-store, store-to-surface, store-to-store and the existing surface-to-surface kernel. Both material labels and opaque colours must match, even for empty receivers; configure them explicitly before transferring. Requested amount is capped by available volume and receiver capacity/headroom. Fields retain their fixed-physics requirement; carried stores can be on rigid objects, but both owners must be unheld for this authoring action. Current revisions, ownership and writable storage are required. One save and Undo updates both endpoints; missing components, numeric refusal and cancellation before acceptance change neither. An accepted save failure preserves the live balances for recovery. Returns actual removedLitres, addedLitres and signed roundingLitres; maximum difference is max(0.000001 litre, removedLitres * 0.000001). Local litres do not rescale with world geometry or infer rigid mass. Store transfers do not resize geometry, spill or mix materials. No liquid-container balance, proximity, shovel gesture, hand pose, grain simulation or automatic physics is inferred. Root placement is preserved through acceptance and Undo/Redo. Stop cannot retract a completed edit and receipt replay never repeats it. Outside temporary play, prepares and publishes its save in the background with one Undo edit. Completion confirms native application and saving. Once preparation begins, newer authored changes invalidate its candidate. Cancellation before native acceptance leaves the requested edit unapplied. After acceptance, stopping cannot retract the edit or its pending save. A save conflict preserves files, blocks further saves and requires inspection; never blindly replay it. Runtime clock and viewer movement continue. Concurrent persisted object edits enter preparation in arrival order after earlier saves drain, without copying a waiting candidate. Stopping or invalidating a waiter releases its place; target changes while waiting require a new request. In a temporary room, changes the live room and local Undo; a kept snapshot makes it durable. Other objects keep running.
